data.name: Dhiyab
data.gender_notes: Dhiyab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is pious and righteous, a follower of the straight path. The name Dhiyab carries the meaning “Righteous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dhiyab usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a strong connection with Allah and a commitment to His teachings.
data.etymology: Dhiyab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhiyab total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ذِياب

in_english.name: Dhiyab
in_english.meaning: Name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), meaning 'to see' or 'to observe'.
in_english.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'dh-y-b' which means 'to see' or 'to observe'. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was known for his bravery and loyalty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhiyab signifies a deep connection to Islamic values, emphasizing the importance of leading a virtuous and righteous life. In some Islamic communities, individuals with this name may be regarded as role models of piety and devotion to their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dhiyab holds great spiritual significance as it is derived from the Arabic root letters "dh-y-b," which literally translate to "upright" or "pious." This name is given to remind the bearer of their responsibility to live a godly life, in accordance with the teachings of the Quran and the Sunnah, and to constantly strive towards purity in heart, mind, and soul. By embracing this name, the individual is encouraged to cultivate a strong and unwavering commitment to their faith and to embody the highest moral and ethical standards.
